composition: Centered claim line sits above a working type tester (size / line-height / letter-spacing). A vertical 'modernism' rail occupies the right edge. Historical surnames form a dense list texture under or beside the tester. Later, a width×weight matrix becomes a full section object.
typography: Exat is used for UI and specimen at once. Weights run Extra Light → Black; widths Condensed / Normal / Wide. Stylistic sets (thin alternates, encapsulated figures, alternate a) are demonstrated as content blocks, not hidden OpenType menus.
palette: #1C1D1E near-black ground, #EEEFEB paper off-white type and panels. Two stops only. No accent CTA color.
geometry: Tester as a centered instrument ~60% of viewport width. Glyph grids with even modular gaps. 7×3 width/weight matrix. Text measure ~70–80% for history passages.
navigation: Almost no global nav. One in-page anchor to the character set. Progression is scroll with a small → cue after the intro.
hero: One sentence about form vs function, then the tester. No dual CTA. The instrument is the hero object.
motion: Kinetic letter behavior and mouse-tied motion on glyphs. Loading animation before the field settles. Scroll continues the specimen rather than triggering unrelated scene changes.
interaction: Sliders write through to live type. Mouse proximity deforms or redraws letter parts. Hover is for glyph inspection, not card lift.
imagery: Almost no photography. Letters, matrices, and name lists are the images.
materials: Ink on paper. Flat fields. No glass, no grain overlay, no 3D extruded type unless a single letter is being inspected.
spatial_rhythm: Intro (claim + tester) → history → matrix → features. Alternates dense list and open tester. No identical py padding.
responsive: Tester sliders must remain usable on a narrow screen; the vertical 'modernism' rail likely folds into a header label. Matrix should become a stacked width group, not a horizontally squashed 7-column table.
signature_motif: Working type tester + historical name-texture sharing one two-color modernist field
rejected_defaults: Inter UI around a preview canvas
centered SaaS pricing for font licenses in the first viewport
